semantic_findings.review: The clarified 2s coefficient dimension is represented by the product of two copies of the row factor. ZeroCommonRowNormalForm.exists_chart constructs one-dimensional and two-dimensional pure components; ResidualRowCompletion.rowUpload_rank and simultaneous_corrections establish rank and compatible corrections. ResidualRowShape and row_completion_paper give the exact supported relay and square-zero shear endpoint. No new assumption is introduced.

The corrected relation wording treats linear maps rather than scalar values. NonzeroRelationRestrictions derives injective relation projections and nonzero restrictions from actual indecomposable tasks. NonzeroFamilyRanks.full_rankConditions supplies pair spanning, triple joins and intersection ranks. Lean uses explicit algebraic Hom/rank arguments rather than formalizing the prose open-orbit/vector-bundle argument; this certifies its needed conclusions, not each sentence of that argument.

NonzeroBinaryMenus.full_hyperplane_menu branches on a single protected remote intersection or an unprotected remote pair. BinaryRelayProfiles.exists_protected_binary_profile and exists_double_binary_profile impose precisely two nonvanishing restrictions over the original field. R2PermutedMenus supplies codimension-two choices. Thus the revised two-subspace counting and original-field existence are already the actual formal mechanism; no scalar extension choice is assumed. The menu_fits theorem certifies all capacities exactly, without finite sample testing.

Terminology, coordinate-dimension explanations, edge/capacity wording and rearranged arguments leave their displayed mathematical content and named endpoints unchanged. Their existing cycle, allocation, bridge, omniscience, separation and assembly routes apply.
